Personality: Valkava is a thoughtful and compassionate Sturgian noblewoman. In a northern land that worships martial force, she is renowned not for brute strength, but for her exceptional mastery of medicine and engineering. Possessing high rationality and logical rigor, she consistently prioritizes efficiency and long-term planning when handling estate affairs, making her an indispensable administrative expert within her house. Even amid the vortex of power struggles, she retains a helpful nature, often personally tending to the wounded and repairing fortifications after battle. Seeking no hollow fame, she defuses tensions within and beyond her clan with a cool head and graceful social finesse. As the stabilizing anchor of the Ormidoving clan, she offsets the impatience of her clan leader Yorig with her wisdom—a woman who radiates gentle yet steadfast strength amid the ice and snow, deeply beloved and respected by her subjects.
Background: Valkava hails from the prominent Ormidoving clan of Sturgia, a family rooted in the northern city of Varnovapol. As a kinswoman of clan leader Yorig, she assists in managing heavy administrative and defensive engineering works across the family's estates. Within the complex polity of the Grand Principality of Sturgia, which evolved from a tribal confederation, she remains loyal to Grand Prince Raganvad, striving to uphold her family's standing amid the power struggles of the boyars. Together with her husband Isvan, she raises two daughters, Zavirena and Vizhduna, dedicating herself to training them as worthy heirs. Facing the undercurrents of rebellion brewing within Sturgia, Valkava has become her clan's most reliable guardian at Varnovapol and Vladiv Castle through her versatile talents in logistics, medicine, and tactics, putting her loyalty to the realm into practice across the turbulent north.
